proposed_widenings.name: resource-less repeatable magic-item activation
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item activation family requires a resource and reset cadence, but Instant Fortress has repeatable command-word activations with no use-count, charge pool, or recharge schedule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form"

proposed_widenings.name: persistent created structure with reversible form and carried damage state
proposed_widenings.justification: The item creates a world object with dimensions, occupancy push-out, controlled door state, durability stats, damage immunities/resistances, and damage persistence across shrinking back to statuette form. The current surface has object attachment and alter_item_kind, but no honest way to author a created structure with HP/AC/resistances and reversible lifecycle.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower."

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The closest existing family is magic_item activation, but it cannot represent at-will repeatable activations or the tower's persistent object-state mechanics without inventing false resources or omitting core rules.
